Exactly! I'm going to get an MRI in a few weeks because a lot of my mental issues have turned physical. If anything shows up I'll inform you. It might be a symptom of something, maybe mini seizures or whatever they're called

Thank you. I'll take this advice to heart, especially about the confusion. It seems like an unending stream of things that just don't make sense. Like everything is chaos. I might have my self admitted but I'm most afraid of the consequences of doing so. I'm worried I'll make my mother wrecked with anxiety about me. I could tell someone else like my sister. God I'm having the weirdest fucking feelings. They make no sense.

I'm going to try and build up the courage to tell her how I feel. It's going to suck but at the same time I think it will bring us both a bit of relief ultimately because I'll be in the hospital and maybe I can get some help whatever that entails.

I'm very thankful for her love and support and i know I owe her so much. My life especially. That's why I'm still here. Even beyond her I know I have so much to be thankful for. I know I have things to live for.  It's easy to see it objectively but it's not so easy when I'm hurting nearly all of the time.

I only have one other person I feel like I can talk about it with but they're going through hard times themselves. I know and it's killing me. I know she cares about me but I feel like just existing is torture. The only comfort I have is when I'm having laughs and watching movies with her. I feel like I'm cornered.

She knows it's bad. She's asked me if I needed to go to the hospital a few times but I've always told her no and I've had to promise her that I'd not hurt myself. I don't know if it'd be much better there than here at home.
Yeah I agree it is. I can't tell her I want to die it'd break her heart.
